notes.title: Klothscape 4th Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
Today is the fourth anniversary of the official establishment of Klothscape, and to celebrate, everything we have released thus far is on sale for a week!

The soundtrack and the supporter DLC for "Go Home, Mr. Fisk!" are both on a 50% sale.

Additionally, our old-school RPG "Eve of Calamity" is cheaper than it ever has been at a 30% sale, and its soundtrack at 10% off for the first time!

"Go Home, Mr. Fisk!": https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711080/Go_Home_Mr_Fisk/

"Eve of Calamity": https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201150/Eve_of_Calamity/

notes.title: Soundtrack streaming service release
notes.notes:
"Go Home, Mr. Fisk!" OST is now available on streaming services.

Listen here: https://share.amuse.io/NDb2uqUcSGbo

notes.title: Third Anniversary Price Cut and Sale
notes.notes:
Today is the third anniversary of the release of "Go Home, Mr. Fisk!" and to celebrate that, we cut the prices of the supporter DLC and soundtrack by half!

In addition to that, they are also 20% off for a week now.

notes.title: Japanese version of Eve of Calamity's demo has been released
notes.notes:
The demo for our upcoming RPG has been available in English for a few months now, and the Japanese version is also finally ready.

In addition, the English version has seen some minor bug fixes and balance changes.

Download here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201150/Eve_of_Calamity/

notes.title: Eve of Calamity demo has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

We have released a free demo for our upcoming old-school RPG, Eve of Calamity.
It contains somewhere between one and two hours of content from the full game.

Download it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201150/Eve_of_Calamity/

notes.title: Free Expansion and Spring Sale!
notes.notes:
Boom, surprise expansion drop!

"Achieve Divinity, Mr. Fisk!" is a new mode, comprising a pool of smaller individual stages to give new challenges for the most dedicated salmon floppers. Every run of the mode randomly selects eight stages from the pool.

Steam's Spring Sale is also here, and with it 40% discounts of the bonus materials, including the new mode's OST. Of course all those who have purchased the OST beforehand also get the new tracks.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711080/Go_Home_Mr_Fisk/

Finally, also check out and wishlist our upcoming old-school RPG, "Eve of Calamity," here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201150/Eve_of_Calamity/

notes.title: Klothscape One-Year Anniversary Sale!
notes.notes:
Today is the 1-year anniversary of us officially registering Klothscape as a company, and we are having a sale to celebrate it! 

Both the supporter DLC and the soundtrack will be 40% off for the next two weeks:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726480/Go_Home_Mr_Fisk__Supporter_DLC/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769110/Go_Home_Mr_Fisk_Soundtrack/

Additionally, now might be a good time to let our players know that we are working on a couple of new games. If you are curious about them, make sure to follow us on twitter:

https://twitter.com/klothscape

Here's to many more years to come!

notes.title: Holiday Content Update
notes.notes:
Happy holidays to all you fishies out there. We have released a small Christmas themed content update that contains the following:

New route through the snowy area; look for a Christmas tree right above the clouds to find a way into a new cave.
A new outfit for Mr. Fisk, found in the new area, with a respective achievement.

In addition, we did some under-the-hood fixing that should make any possible future updates easier for us to implement. This should not affect normal gameplay, but if you do notice something off, please let us know.

notes.title: Nominate us at the Steam Awards!
Added Japanese localization to achievements
notes.notes: Japanese localization of the achievements is live.

notes.title: Post launch patch
notes.notes:
The improvements in this patch contain:
[list]
[*]Changed mouse input to register primary button instead of left button
[*]Added a sign in the well that should make the way forward more obvious
[*]Small tweaks to graphics
[/list]
The default Steam Input settings for Mr. Fisk have also been updated. Xbox controllers should now work without the need to disconnect and reconnect after launching the game.

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes: [i]Go Home, Mr. Fisk![/i] has been released to the public! Play the game for free now.

notes.title: Early access keys available
notes.notes:
Go Home, Mr. Fisk! will be officially released in just five days, on 9.27.2021, but early access keys are available now for influencers on Keymailer: https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/132943

If you are interested in playing the game right away but are not an influencer, simply reach out to us on Twitter (https://twitter.com/klothscape) or through email (klothscape[at]gmail.com) and request a key.
